tracker_error: QA Tracker is unavailable or the bounded request expired
target: Freshly forged Diablo equipment in the Ordo Perfectus Elden Ring profile
environment: Actual installed Elden Ring game, fully restarted after forging
build: codex/loot-refinement; use docs/REFINEMENT_VALIDATION.json identities and the corresponding repair commit.
steps: Compare early and endgame rolls of the same base item, rarity and upgrade level.
Verify HP, FP, stamina, regeneration and protection passives while equipping and unequipping.
Exercise weapon attack casts, shield guard casts/healing, armor retaliation and incoming-damage healing.
Observe each cooldown; check no idle attack casts and no damage proc merely from equipping armor.
Check dead-player, rest, reload, unequip and equipment-swap transitions.
Disable additional passives/combat magic, reforge and restart; confirm prior effects disappear.
Reforge the same seed twice; verify stats do not accumulate and external field edits remain intact.
Equip fire/lightning/glintstone/holy/frost/blood/poison/rot/renewal gear and confirm matching visuals in both hands and each armor slot.
Apply grease, spell and Ash of War buffs over cosmetic auras; confirm buff eligibility, damage and timers are unchanged, the temporary visual takes precedence and the aura returns after expiration.
Disable auras alone, reforge and restart; compare identical-seed stats/passives and confirm only the cosmetic visuals disappear.
Acquire newly generated armor from boss, chest, NPC and vendor routes; verify every piece and both player bodies.
Check newly acquired weapon name/rarity/caption agreement at reinforcement levels 0 and above; inspect accessory equipment menus for valid names/icons.
At First Step and ingredient gathering nodes, verify no added gear rewards; rest, quit/reload and revisit opened chests with world-reset hotkeys unused.
Defeat a qualifying boss, collect its original reward plus generated gear; verify ordinary respawns do not repeat the award.
Visit a verified vendor, purchase a custom item, rest and reload; original stock remains and purchased custom stock stays sold out.
Compare the new starter rolls with the same-rarity later regional gear; verify discovery and additive attributes do not retain full unscaled bonuses.
Inspect all four armor slots: damage negation must be ordinary per-piece values, never 100 across the board; compare against native armor of the same weight.

With identical character stats and reinforcement, compare an early legendary katana against Uchigatana: original physical damage and 45 bleed must remain, with useful added bonuses; measure real hits and procs.
Verify FP/stamina bonuses increase starting-character resource totals, and buildup/passive effects do not display or behave as zero.
Inspect vanilla names, full descriptions and item-info text in base/DLC menus; no LootForge rarity/lore replacement. Compare restored vanilla purchase/sale values.
Verify custom vendor prices reflect actual combat strength rather than the rarity/tier label; record observed buy/sell values against the deployed report.
Reforge once with weapon auras on and armor auras off, then swap the booleans; verify independent visuals with unchanged same-seed mechanics.
Reroll then disable infusion; verify inherited status buildup and original passive UI entries return without stale zero-value lines.
expected: Regional power scales; magic is limited to rare Legendary/Mythic rolls and the right equipment category; disabling options removes previous effects on reforge.
limits: Armor retaliation is a magic burst, not attacker-specific percentage reflection. Native data and Qt checks do not prove combat behavior.
evidence_required: Retained game video/screenshots, seed, item IDs, game build, source revision, output hashes and timestamps
next_action: Submit this assignment to the QA tracker when reachable, then execute the game checks.
